ai_summary: Ather Energy Limited has formally disclosed its participation in an upcoming virtual investor and analyst meeting, the "Arihant Capital's Bharat Connect Conference," scheduled for September 29, 2026. This is a routine regulatory filing under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, aimed at informing stakeholders about investor engagement. There are no immediate material impacts or red flags associated with this disclosure, as the company confirms discussions will be based solely on publicly available information and no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information will be shared.
